title: BA1/133/2017 of Suraj Saini Vs State Of Uttarakhand

paras.text:
CRLR No. 133 of 2017
With
Bail Application No. 776 of 2017
Honíble V.K. Bist, J.
Mr. B.S. Adhikari, Advocate with Mr.
Vinay Bhatt, Advocate for the revisionist.
Mr. Prem Kaushal, Brief Holder for
the State.
Heard.
Admit the revision.
Summon the lower court record.
It has been submitted by the learned
counsel for the revisionist that the
revisionist/ applicant was on bail during
trial as well as during the pendency of
appeal and has never misused the liberty
of bail given to him.
Considering the submission of
learned counsel for the revisionist and
after going through the papers on record,
the revisionist / applicant is directed to be
released on bail during the pendency of
the revision, on same terms and
conditions on which he was granted bail
by the trial court.
List after lower court record is
received.
Deposition of fine shall be condition
precedent for release of the appellants on
bail during pendency of the present
criminal appeal.
Bail application stands disposed of.
Let a certified copy of the order be
issued today itself.
